metadata.title: Container Secrets Management

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Secrets handling and runtime exposure risks in containers.

metadata.remarks: Defines trust properties ensuring that secrets used by containerized workloads are never embedded in images, are injected at runtime, and are subject to lifecycle control.

components.title: Runtime Secret Injection
components.description: Secrets are injected at runtime and never embedded in container images.

components.title: Container Secret Lifecycle Control
components.description: Secrets have defined rotation and revocation semantics.

components.title: Secret Exposure Prevention
components.description: Controls preventing secrets from leaking via logs, metadata APIs, or environment variables.
